definitions.explanation: The continent of North America, typically referring to the United States, Canada, and Mexico.

examples.japanese: {北米|ほくべい}に{住|す}んでいる。
この{製品|せいひん}は{北米|ほくべい}{市場|しじょう}で{人気|にんき}がある。
examples.english: This product is popular in the North American market.

examples.japanese: {北米|ほくべい}と{南米|なんべい}を{合|あ}わせてアメリカ{大陸|たいりく}と{呼|よ}ぶ。
examples.english: North America and South America together are called the Americas.

notes:
USAGE:
Abbreviation of {北|きた}アメリカ. Part of a series of continent/region abbreviations using kanji: {北米|ほくべい} (North America), {南米|なんべい} (South America), {欧米|おうべい} (the West / Europe and America).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {北米|ほくべい}{市場|しじょう} (North American market)
- {北米|ほくべい}{大陸|たいりく} (North American continent)
- {北米|ほくべい}{地域|ちいき} (North American region)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {南米|なんべい}: South America
- {欧米|おうべい}: Europe and America, the West
- {中南米|ちゅうなんべい}: Central and South America
